records.candidate_sentence: TARA: 4 {{gap_4}} (be) the auditorium sound quality satisfactory?
records.task022_rationale: In standard English, 'acoustics' (acoustic properties of a hall) functions as a plural noun requiring 'Were'. Changing the head noun to the singular compound 'auditorium sound quality' makes the target answer 'Was' ('Was the auditorium sound quality satisfactory?') grammatically flawless, natural, and unambiguous, without altering the target answer key or any other gap.
